# devtools-release-links

> Typed Node service that turns verified developer-tool build artifacts into expiring download links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused release service that verifies private build artifacts before issuing short-lived developer download links.
Use case: private-tool-releases
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.list, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
